content:
The HWPX document generation failed because the required string format for project phases was not found in the output XML.
The test_legacy_pytest_suite failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, the assertion `assert f"{value} (3개월)" in combined` failed because the expected string '요구사항 분석 및 설계 (2026-08 ~ 2026-10) (3개월)' was missing from the generated section XML. While the environment and basic XML structure were correctly set up, the data injection logic failed to produce the exact concatenated string required by the verifier.
